title: Active `await` keeps unexpected reference for RefCounted object when the `await` holder is freed before the `await` returned
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

### System information

Win 11

### Issue description

An active `await` to a RefCounted object will result in memory leaking when the `await` holder is freed before `await` returned. 

------
See the sample code below.

In the `_ready()` function, I created two RefCounted object `shell` and `leaker`. And start a chained `await` by `shell.bind_leaker()` (`shell` -> `leaker` -> `SceneTreeTimer.timeout`).

Because of the [issue](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/81210), the `shell` will lost reference count and be freed after leaving `_ready()`'s scope. 

**Here is the point:** In my expectation, the `leaker` should be freed immediately after the `shell` freed. However, it does not happen, and the `leaker` even not be freed after the SceneTreeTimer timeout.

It seems that the freed `shell`'s `await` still keeps reference count to the `leaker`, which results in memory leaking of the `leaker` RefCounted object. 

### Steps to reproduce

Attach the script to a Node and run the scene.

```gdscript
extends Node

func _ready() -> void:
	var shell = Shell.new("0")
	var leaker = Leaker.new("0")
	shell.bind_leaker(leaker, 0.5)
	#await shell.bind_leaker(leaker, 0.5) # await here can keep Shell's ref count, will free Shell and Leaker correctly
	return

class Shell extends RefCounted:
	var name : String
	
	func _init(_name : String) -> void:
		self.name = _name
		print("Shell {0} is created".format([self.name]))
		return
	
	func _notification(what: int) -> void:
		if what == NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE:
			print("Shell {0} is freed".format([name]))
		return
	
	func bind_leaker(leaker : Leaker, t : float) -> void:
		#var test = self # uncomment this to keep Shell's ref count (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/81210#issuecomment-1701923904)
		await leaker.start(t)
		print("Shell {0} is timeout".format([name]))
		return
	
	pass

class Leaker extends RefCounted:
	var name : String
	
	func _init(_name : String) -> void:
		self.name = _name
		print("Leaker {0} is created".format([self.name]))
		return
	
	func _notification(what : int) -> void:
		if what == NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE:
			print("Leaker {0} is freed".format([name]))
		return
	
	func start(time : float) -> void:
		var timer = (Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree).create_timer(time)
		await timer.timeout
		print("Leaker {0} is timeout".format([name]))
		return

```


The expected output should be:
```
Shell 0 is created
Leaker 0 is created
Shell 0 is freed
Leaker 0 is freed
```

However it prints:
```
Shell 0 is created
Leaker 0 is created
Shell 0 is freed
Leaker 0 is timeout
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[await-memory-leak.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26900369/await-memory-leak.zip)
